name: Life Sciences Research Foundation Postdoctoral Fellowship
other_rules: PhD (or MD/DVM, whichever later) within 5 years of 1 October of the application year
postdoc lab start between 1 August of the previous year and 31 July of the following year
must be a different lab from the thesis lab
US citizens may work anywhere, non-US citizens only in US labs
notes: Basic life sciences, sponsored by companies and foundations. 2027 awards: deadline 31 Oct 2026, start 1 Aug 2027.
